packages.name: mere
packages.description: The composed graph library behind Turnstone and other graph-shaped applications.

packages.name: mere-apparatus
packages.description: Bounded diagnostic observations beneath product-owned inspection views.

packages.name: uxtree
packages.description: Portable a11y / automation tree for the Mere browser — projects mere structural elements into AccessKit nodes.

packages.name: inker
packages.description: Modular engine/renderer controller — selects and orchestrates content engines (genet HTML lanes, nematic smolweb, scrying/graft/weld surface engines).

packages.name: nematic
packages.description: Portable smolweb rendering engine — Gemini, Gopher, Markdown, feeds, and the knot note format, lowered to the inker document model.

packages.name: errand
packages.description: Async small-web (smolweb) transport: gemini, gopher, finger, spartan, nex, guppy, and titan in one scheme-routed fetch, plus titan-upload and misfin-send write companions. Bytes in, bytes out, no HTTP, host-agnostic.

packages.name: mere-fleece
packages.description: Content gathering for Mere: bounded traversal, clipping and capture over supplied documents and engine outputs.

packages.name: eidetic
packages.description: Portable intake, typed retained content and memory for Mere, independent of concrete storage and network adapters.

packages.name: chartulary
packages.description: The generic content-addressed container graph (aka chart). Graph<N, E> on petgraph with capability traits, default Container/Relation payloads, RDF projection (`chartulary::rdf`), and the lineage layer (`chartulary::stemma`). The substrate binds muniment's blobs and journals into an app-agnostic graph.

packages.name: muniment
packages.description: A portable persistence floor: host-supplied byte backends, typed mutable slots, content-addressed immutable blobs, and append-only journals. Format-agnostic and wasm-friendly.

packages.name: incipit
packages.description: Workspace identity vocabulary for Mere: the stable ids of a graph and a session, with no dependency on the graph itself.

packages.name: mere-linked-data
packages.description: JSON-LD export/import bridge between the Mere graph kernel and linked data.

packages.name: mere-kernel
packages.description: Portable identity, authority, and mutation kernel for the Mere browser. Renamed from graphshell-core.

packages.name: command-menu
packages.description: The commands a host offers, the person's choices among them, and a palette's in-progress state.

packages.name: mere-forme
packages.description: Per-graph-view workbench arrangement authority for Mere — projects graph members + edges into a workbench arrangement (tree-shaped or otherwise)

packages.name: mere-curation
packages.description: View-local graph curation for Mere: subgraph specifications now, folds and other per-view curation as they arrive.

packages.name: numen
packages.description: Field algebra for graph canvases: portable field truth plus evaluation, registry, projection, Rhai authoring, and opt-in Burn lowering. Seiche integrates the force laws.

packages.name: armillary
packages.description: A host-neutral actor-kernel runtime: a !Send host-kernel boundary, a Send actor harness (thread-per-actor or pooled), generation counters for backpressure, and a growable reusing worker pool. GPUI's kernel/actor discipline made structural.

packages.name: mere-fetch
packages.description: Host-neutral fetch actor and session-cookie runtime for Mere.

packages.name: mere-page-load
packages.description: Mere's fetch vocabulary and the sans-IO page load: one document's request identity, supersede, Stop, streaming and typed outcome, with no transport or clock of its own.

packages.name: pandect
packages.description: Pandect: session manifests, graph and view sidecars, worker declarations, graph-reference adapters, settings and the persona wallet carry lane.

packages.name: mere-alembic
packages.description: Alembic is the recall and workshop component of Distillery, the Mere platform's works: the memory surfaces (short-term, long-term, codicils, search) behind a `recall` feature, and the granted-agent and automation workshop over them — create, grant, run, observe, interrupt, and dissolve a bounded actor. Athanor (mere-athanor), the distillation furnace, is its authority half and the first such actor. Inside Distillery since 2026-09-02: Distillery runs models, its Alembic component runs work over them.

packages.name: tabard
packages.description: Shared theme-authoring library: Tinct seeds in, typed DTCG design tokens and Livery CSS custom-property stylesheets out.

packages.name: tinct
packages.description: Perceptual (OKLCH) seed-to-palette derivation, plus a contrast-gated syntax-highlight palette, for the Merely family (Woodshed, Hocket, Mere). A theme is a few seed colours; the full palette is derived.

packages.name: servitor
packages.description: Capability-scoped resident helpers for graph applications: a participant holds a scoped structural capability and proposes changes through a validating gate, attributed and revision-checked.

packages.name: pictograph
packages.description: Derives compact IconVG node faces deterministically from content addresses, with palette-backed theming and built-in level of detail. Its optional vello feature decodes IconVG into the exact scene type consumed by netrender.

packages.name: mere-cartography
packages.description: Non-destructive projection layer for Mere — contracts between graph truth + intelligence signals on the input side and canvas swatches on the output side. Owns LayoutStrategy trait, Projection/Overlay/MinimapDescriptor types, and the narrow IntelligenceSignals shape that firewalls cartography from embed internals.

packages.name: sceno
packages.description: Core contracts for the scenograph projection engine: source references, coordinate spaces, footprints, persisted scores, and scene instances carrying representation slots and emphasis channels.

packages.name: scenomise
packages.description: Choreography for the scenograph projection engine: placement algorithms that realize persisted scores into arranged scenes.

packages.name: scenograph
packages.description: Host-neutral authoring model for durable Scenograph projection definitions.

packages.name: scenotime
packages.description: Runtime for the scenograph projection engine: stable epochs, idempotent diffs, host-clocked transitions, and picking.

packages.name: edit-history
packages.description: Undo and redo over whole-document snapshots, with keyed coalescing on a host clock and a saved marker.

packages.name: chirograph
packages.description: Chirograph: the projection contract, executed in duplicate. Versioned, carrier-neutral messages by which an endpoint offers a scene, a resource, or an action, and a host asks for one -- named for the medieval deed written twice on a sheet and cut through the writing, so the two halves prove each other by matching.

packages.name: esp
packages.description: Portable inference and embedding seams for local, browser, and remote model execution.

packages.name: eidetic-search
packages.description: Lexical search over eidetic browsing memory — the Phase 9 producer half: an in-tree BM25 index minted from BrowsingTrace codicils, weighted-field recall, stored-column reports, and the engine-agnostic hybrid-fusion seam.

packages.name: seiche
packages.description: Kernel-free, rapier-backed force-directed graph layout: bodies bound to node keys, themable and tensorized force laws, and numen field couplings. A host feeds node keys + positions; seiche integrates.

packages.name: conatus
packages.description: Host-neutral 3D body, collision, query, and fixed-step runtime for Merely spatial applications and games.

packages.name: nisus
packages.description: Generic revisioned voxel chunk and edit mechanics for Merely spatial applications and games.

packages.name: platen
packages.description: The pane home for the Mere browser — compiles forme arrangements into workbench plans, tile trees, and pane geometry; the press in the printing metaphor. Decomposed 2026-07-09: the graph-scene paint lane moved to the canvas crate.

packages.name: document-canvas
packages.description: Document-view canvas — parley-driven layout for inker::EngineDocument; emits portable render packets parallel to graph-canvas.

packages.name: workbench
packages.description: Reusable split-and-tab workspace organization for Genet hosts.

packages.name: mere-chrome
packages.description: Graphshell domain layer for the Mere browser — root toolbar, app menu, address/omnibar, window chrome view-models. Re-exported through shell-state for the runtime.

packages.name: mere-comms
packages.description: Mere's portable comms model: conversations, messages, identities and local drafts, with opt-in Misfin and Murm adapters and a Moot Commons-chat consumer.

packages.name: luggage
packages.description: Self-update for packaged apps: signed manifests over pluggable feeds (HTTP, directory, GitHub Releases). A fork of cargo-packager-updater carrying the Merely family's update posture.

packages.name: mere-framing
packages.description: A magic-and-version header for stored and sent postcard records.

packages.name: state-witness
packages.description: A labelled FNV-1a state witness: keyed entries, a first-divergence report and a tick trace.

packages.name: content-contract
packages.description: Content worker command/update message contract and transferable transport for Mere.

packages.name: mere-proofs
packages.description: Typed digests, commitments, blob references, and proof envelopes for Mere domains.

packages.name: shell-state
packages.description: Portable shell session state for the Mere browser — focus authorities, command palette, omnibar, toolbar, frame view-models, and UX state types.

packages.name: ux-events
packages.description: Portable chrome-event taxonomy for the Mere browser — UxEvent + UxObserver + UxProbe + diagnostics-channel bridge + command-surface telemetry. The third pillar between code-level tracing and registry-level register-diagnostics.

packages.name: mere-registry
packages.description: Mere's late-binding registries: diagnostics channels, input bindings, knowledge tags, layout domains, lenses, mods, protocol contracts, themes and viewers, one feature each.

packages.name: mora-cmudict
packages.description: Offline CMUdict pronunciation provider for the mora prosody engine.

packages.name: reference-data
packages.description: Opt-in, validated local lexical reference packs; no executable code or network transport.

packages.name: stickleback
packages.description: A shared replicated-space runtime for signed peer domains: joined p2panda spaces and their drain, policy-before-insert operation processing, muniment-backed storage, retention checkpoints, and native drop carriage. The domain supplies its own grammar, addressing, and authorization.

packages.name: mere-persona-picker
packages.description: The persona picker: a Cambium view over a personae vault's roster. Every Merely application asks the same question — which persona am I? — so the list convention lives here rather than being re-drawn per app.

packages.name: cambium
packages.description: A Meristem backend and application toolkit for Genet

packages.name: illume
packages.description: Portable, pure-Rust, wasm-safe text lexer and syntax highlighter: djot structure plus a pluggable inner-language injection registry over a logos pack, and a prose-entity pass (URLs, mentions, tags). Host- and toolkit-agnostic; emits (range, kind) spans, no UI dependency.

packages.name: mere-surface-api
packages.description: Application host contracts above Genet: the settings projection and product surface admission vocabulary. Mere's half of the former genet-host-api, homed here until the platform boundary plan moves it.

packages.name: meristem
packages.description: The reactive diff and message core of the Cambium GUI toolkit

packages.name: sprigging
packages.description: Retained custom-paint leaves and arrangement helpers for Rust GUI hosts

packages.name: gemot
packages.description: Community domain and assembly layer for Moot governance, replication, Standing, Tulpa, and FLORA.

packages.name: mien
packages.description: A mien is a persona's standing as one moot sees it: reputation in the Mere platform's moot tier, which is per-moot primary with no global score. A viewer moot folds its own ledger together with the moots it concords, one hop and no further, under a composition policy it chooses. A mien is therefore always someone's view of someone, never an objective fact about them.

packages.name: mooting
packages.description: Protocol core for community social-primitives selection — inner layer of gemot for the Mere browser.

packages.name: moothold
packages.description: Tier 3 federation of Gemot moots: concord and reciprocal resource sharing.

packages.name: mere-mesh
packages.description: The personal-space compute mesh: signed job operations over the LogSync event-DAG, a deterministic job board, and the worker loop. Resource-coordination milestone 1 (own devices, no economy).

packages.name: script-rhai
packages.description: Rhai backend for the knot block-evaluator lane: an inker BlockEvaluator over the Rhai scripting engine (pure Rust, sandboxed, native operation budget).

packages.name: hagiograph
packages.description: The history organ: standing marks along product-defined axes, feats judged against them, and deep time that gives a generated world its past. Judges and generates history; storage stays in journals.

packages.name: modulus
packages.description: Product-neutral sparse brick atlas ABI and WGSL voxel traversal for Merely spatial applications and games.

packages.name: tenant
packages.description: The lit body tenant: rigid and glTF bodies rasterised on the host's device into the host's targets, lit by the stack's light block and depth-joined with a tracer.

packages.name: graphshell-client
packages.description: Transport-independent local curation state for Graphshell.

packages.name: graphshell-endpoint
packages.description: Application-injected projection and intent boundary for Graphshell.

packages.name: graphshell
packages.description: Graphshell presentation host and loopback acceptance view.

packages.name: cambium-rootstock
packages.description: The stock a Cambium application host is grafted onto: input vocabulary, routing, layout, paint, and accessibility, with no event source of its own

packages.name: cambium-winit
packages.description: winit input translation for Cambium applications

packages.name: distillery
packages.description: The model-works port of the Mere platform: a host for mesh-supervised inference, embedding, and training jobs.

packages.name: mere-document-lanes
packages.description: Mere's document content lanes above Genet: the reader and smolweb sessions over the portable document canvas, and the remote resource fetcher over netfetcher and errand. Mere's half of the former genet-documents; landed in mere 2026-09-03 by the platform boundary plan.

packages.name: mere-view
packages.description: The mere view: a mere's sessions and graph as one Cambium component every application embeds.

packages.name: cambium-genet-winit-host
packages.description: The single-root Cambium desktop host: winit lifecycle, Livery/Buckram layout and paint, input routing, and AccessKit sync over one GenetAppRunner

packages.name: cambium-winit-a11y
packages.description: AccessKit hosting for genet-backed Cambium applications on winit

packages.name: mesquite
packages.description: The scenario lane for a Cambium document host: ticks a taproot scenario per presented frame, arms captures, writes PNGs and one JSON receipt, checks pixels, accounts cost, and sets the exit code, behind a Product trait each app implements

packages.name: pelt-core
packages.description: Window-neutral retained-session controller for the Pelt reference browser.

packages.name: mere-moot
packages.description: Gemot community surface: murmurs, moots, and coop. Composes existing conversation, governance, and shared-activity domains; technical package mere-moot.

packages.name: djinn
packages.description: Local-first desktop resident composition for the Mere stack: identity, local sessions, personal sync, Knot, credential custody, and endpoint ownership.

packages.name: castellan
packages.description: Castellan is the credential-keeper port of the Mere platform: the officer of the gate who holds your chatelaine (secrets: passwords, 2FA seeds, tokens) and presents your insignia (graded proofs of identity), in trust for your personae. Hosts embed views; only the castellan touches secrets, and every release is a gate petition.

packages.name: gazette
packages.description: Gazette is the Mere platform's directory port: it resolves who someone is into where they can be reached, hands what it learns to gaz to keep, reads what they publish, and announces the presentations castellan issues. Built today: an embeddable contact Ledger projection, WebFinger (RFC 7033) resolution and unverified Gaz address intake. Live gaz-store hosting, NIP-05, atproto-did, the moot web-of-trust directory, feed polling, and the reading room remain. Not castellan, which guards and presents you.

packages.name: djinn-testkit
packages.description: Test harness for djinn residents: isolated spawns, walls around the installed resident, and verified receipts.

packages.name: dramatis-app
packages.description: Persona selection and quarantine review through the Djinn resident.

packages.name: mere-athanor
packages.description: Athanor is the distillation furnace of Distillery, the Mere platform's works: the authority half of Alembic's workshop — what a furnace pass is, what it may propose (distillation, cleanup, facet proposals), and the grants, runs, petitions, and revocation over bounded actors. It proposes and never becomes graph-truth authority; Djinn schedules it as one resident service.

packages.name: mere-signalman
packages.description: Private Mere port for commissioning and operating Retinue stations through djinn.

packages.name: tabard-desktop
packages.description: Native desktop host for Tabard's shared appearance workshop

packages.name: tabard-workshop
packages.description: Tabard's reusable appearance workshop surface and authored-theme workflow

packages.name: pelt
packages.description: Pelt: the reference browser port over Genet's engine and Cambium's retained shell.

packages.name: pelt-desktop
packages.description: Pelt's desktop shell: the winit/wgpu present stack and the engine lanes behind it.

packages.name: scrying-engine
packages.description: inker SurfaceEngine implementation backed by the scrying system-WebView producer (WebView2 / WKWebView / WebKitGTK).

packages.name: knot-editor-host
packages.description: Host-side reuse-lexers for the knot editor: precise inner-language injection over parsers the workspace already ships, layered as overrides on the portable illume pack. Markdown via pulldown-cmark today; CSS/HTML/JS/Turtle to follow.

packages.name: cambium-genet-web-host
packages.description: The browser event source for a Cambium application host: DOM events and a canvas, grafted onto cambium-rootstock

packages.name: graft-engine
packages.description: inker SurfaceEngine implementation backed by the wgpu-graft Servo embedding (GL-FBO / DX12-shared / Vulkan-external-memory / IOSurface interop).

packages.name: weld-engine
packages.description: inker SurfaceEngine implementation backed by the wgpu-weld CEF (Chromium) accelerated-OSR embedding.
